plain_english_policy: This bill mandates that anyone applying for a new license as a used motor vehicle dealer or wholesaler in Alabama must complete an approved education seminar before submitting their application, effective October 1, 2010. The State Department of Revenue is tasked with enforcing this requirement and approving the content of these seminars to ensure they cover legal requirements such as federal/state laws, paperwork for sales, and title processes.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would create a new regulatory barrier to entry for used car dealerships and wholesalers by requiring pre-licensure training. This aims to standardize knowledge of state motor vehicle regulations among business owners before they begin operating, with the stated intent of protecting the public.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representatives Thigpen, Harper and Beasley affirmatively advanced this bill.
evidence_quotes: "On and after October 1, 2010, new applicants for licensure as either a used motor vehicle dealer or as a motor vehicle wholesaler shall meet the requirements of subsection (d)."

"Beginning October 1, 2010, every person who applies for a new license...shall provide to the commission...acceptable proof that the applicant has completed a used motor vehicle education seminar or a motor vehicle wholesaler education seminar, as applicable."
